input_messages.content: Hi! I recently bought a digital camera from your store, but it doesn’t zoom in as much as I was hoping. I use it mainly for bird-watching, so I really need something with the highest possible zoom. I’d like to exchange it for a model with the maximum zoom you have, but I want all the other features to stay the same. Price isn’t an issue, and I’d like to get this sorted out as quickly as possible. Can you help me with this?
Sure, I don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my order.
I don’t have the order ID handy, so if you could list my recent orders, that would be really helpful. Thanks!

Yes, please go ahead and find the camera with the highest zoom for me. I confirm that I want to exchange the camera from order #W4689314, and I’d like all the other features to stay the same as much as possible—just with the maximum zoom you have. I don’t have any other preferences, and I’d like to get this done as soon as possible.

That sounds perfect, but I’d like to pay the price difference using my PayPal account instead of my Mastercard. Can you charge the $170.68 to my PayPal? And yes, the camera is the only item I want to exchange from that order. Please go ahead with the exchange as soon as possible.

Thank you so much for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions. That’s all I needed for now. Have a great day!
